title: The score readout hits its own stated ceiling ('Score: 366/366') around turn 517, roughly 80 turns and 5 of 8 holds before the actual ending (turn 597) — after that the number stops telling the player anything about how much realm or story is left, even though status keeps saying 'it can fill long before the tale ends.'
